# Story 25.1: Red-phase tests for column spread (flex-grow) in dms-base-table

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase unit tests asserting that `.dms-header-cell` and `.dms-body-cell` in `dms-base-table` declare a flex shorthand with grow enabled (`flex: 1 1 auto`) so columns spread to fill the row width while configured widths still render as their basis,
so that Story 25.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass and the regression where columns stopped spreading is locked in.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A unit test extracts the top-level `.dms-header-cell { ... }` rule body from `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.scss` (matching only the column-0 line so a nested/indented recurrence does not shadow it) and asserts it declares a flex shorthand with grow = 1 and basis `auto` — i.e. matches `/flex:\s*1\s+1\s+auto/`.
2. A unit test performs the same extraction + assertion for the top-level `.dms-body-cell { ... }` rule body.
3. Both tests are marked `.skip()` in code (`it.skip`) so the dms-material Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 25.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. All pre-existing tests remain unskipped and green.
4. The spec file runs green under `nx test dms-material` immediately after this story (new assertions skipped), and Story 25.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against the current SCSS (`flex: 0 1 auto`), then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a red-phase test for the header-cell flex rule.
  - [ ] 1.1 Create `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table-column-spread.spec.ts` that reads `base-table.component.scss` from disk and extracts the top-level `.dms-header-cell { ... }` rule body (column-0 match only).
  - [ ] 1.2 Assert the extracted header rule matches `/flex:\s*1\s+1\s+auto/`. Mark the test `it.skip`.
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add a red-phase test for the body-cell flex rule.
  - [ ] 2.1 In the same spec, extract the top-level `.dms-body-cell { ... }` rule body and assert it matches `/flex:\s*1\s+1\s+auto/`. Mark the test `it.skip`.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3, #4): Confirm green with skips.
  - [ ] 3.1 Run `nx test dms-material` and confirm fully green with only the two new red-phase assertions skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** Story 10.3 set `flex: 0 1 auto;` on both `.dms-header-cell` (line ~83) and `.dms-body-cell` (line ~148) in `base-table.component.scss` to make the inline `[style.width.px]` binding take effect against Material MDC's default `mat-cell, mat-header-cell { flex: 1 }`. That fixed "configured widths ignored" but disabled flex-grow, so cells now take exactly their configured width and never expand — columns no longer spread over the full row width. This story locks in the fix contract before Story 25.2 changes the SCSS.
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 25.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while the SCSS still says `flex: 0 1 auto`; Story 25.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then changes both rules to `flex: 1 1 auto` until green.
- **Do NOT modify `base-table.component.scss` in this story** — test scaffold only. The SCSS change belongs to Story 25.2.
- **SCSS-source assertion convention:** the dms-material test environment does not inject component SCSS into the DOM (computed styles resolve empty on a rendered cell), so these tests assert the source rule rather than `getComputedStyle` — matching the existing `base-table-numeric-alignment.spec.ts` and Story 5.x convention for a genuine red→green signal.
- **Extraction helper:** match only the column-0 `.dms-header-cell {` / `.dms-body-cell {` line so an indented/nested recurrence (e.g. inside `.dark-theme`) does not shadow the shared block; walk braces to capture the full rule body, mirroring `numericCellRuleBody()` in `base-table-numeric-alignment.spec.ts`.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; dms-material tests run via `nx test dms-material`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create: `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table-column-spread.spec.ts` (red-phase SCSS-source assertions, both tests skipped).
- No changes to production `.scss` or component code in this story.
